title: PostgreSQL Minor Version Upgrade
purpose: Apply the latest PostgreSQL minor release, which includes performance fixes for checkpoint I/O under bulk writes (see the June 12 replication lag incident).
expectedImpact: Up to 2 minutes of API 5xx during a rolling primary switchover. Notification ingest will be paused and queued automatically; queues will drain after the switchover completes.

updates.author: Amina Yusuf, SRE
updates.details: Maintenance scheduled. All times UTC. We will publish progress updates here during the window.
